description: What is happening in crypto and equity markets, written up from posts across many sources.. level=events: what happened, what it names, how prices reacted where measured (impacts is empty on most events), and the posts behind it. level=storylines: the events of one development, threaded over days. level=arcs: storylines grouped into a larger movement. Search any level by topic with q, filter by asset with entityIds from the entities tool, or fetch up to 30 you hold with ids. Not returned: post text, a sentiment score or a price.

alertAction.description: level=events. alert: judged impactful. monitor: worth watching.

arcId.description: level=events. Events in one arc's storylines.

assetClass.description: level=events: events tied to this market by what they name, plus events tied to neither, such as macro news; a repeated query can return fewer as names get linked to assets. level=arcs: arcs with at least 15% of their events naming an asset in this market, then macro arcs.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous reply. Change any argument but limit and it fails; start again without it.

entityIds.description: Up to 30 ids from the entities tool. Matches any of them.

eventClass.description: level=events. market: a development reported across posts. asset: posts about one asset. call: accounts taking positions.

eventType.description: level=events. What kind of development it is.

from.description: level=events or storylines. Start of the range, unix seconds, not milliseconds. Required unless you fetch by ids or search with q. Arcs take no from. api_status returns historyFrom, the earliest time your plan reads.

hasStoryline.description: level=events. true keeps events in a storyline, false those in none.

ids.description: Fetch up to 30 you already hold, by id. No from needed.

implication.description: level=events. Which way it cuts for the assets it names.

limit.description: Items per page, up to 30. Keep it small and page with cursor rather than asking for everything at once.

notable.description: level=events. true drops events their storyline marked as not material.

novelty.description: level=events. update: a later reading of a story already served.

q.description: Search by topic, best match first, for example "stablecoin regulation". from becomes optional.

relation.description: level=storylines. Storylines holding an event of this relation.

sort.description: level=events: latest (default), or relevant, which ranks the last 24 hours and takes no from. level=arcs: latest, storylines or events.

status.description: level=storylines: open (default; every status with q), dormant or any. level=arcs: active (default) or retired.

to.description: level=events or storylines. End of the range, unix seconds. Defaults to now.

name: events
title: Events
